basis: Jinshu 053 and ZZTJ 083 both name 杜錫 as the Eastern Palace officer who remonstrated Minhuai; both narrate needles sewn into the felt where 錫 sat.
ZZTJ 083 states 錫，預之子也; Jinshu 093 in 杜乂's opening calls 尚書左丞錫 the son of 預 (鎮南將軍預孫，尚書左丞錫之子也).
notes: Western Jin 杜錫, son of 預: 053/ZZTJ 舍人/中舍人 pricked by needles after remonstrating the heir; 093 尚書左丞錫, father of 杜乂. Same personal name plus father 預, not romanization or office reuse alone.

basis: Jinshu 053 司空泰息略 is assigned with 華暠息恆 to attend the heir; 037 孝王略，字元簡 in early Yuankang 略與華恆等並侍左右.
037 lists 泰四子：越、騰、略、模 and 弟略立, matching 053's 泰息略.
045 高密王略 faces 劉根; 037 孝王略 is attacked by 劉根 at Linzi; 037 恭王俊出嗣高密王略 ties the Gaomi title to this 略.
notes: One 略, son of 司空泰, courtesy 元簡, Prince Xiao and Prince of Gaomi: Minhuai companion with 華恆; Qingzhou; 劉根; sacrificial line later filled by 俊. Given name plus father, courtesy, and the same two episode chains.

basis: Both texts name 陳舞 as the maid Empress Jia sent with wine to intoxicate the heir, then pressing him as 不孝 when he refused three sheng.
notes: Same full personal name 陳舞 and the same Minhuai deposition episode (side room, forced wine, unfilial taunt). ZZTJ 婢陳舞 and Jinshu 婢陳舞 are one person.

basis: Later Zhou annal installs 符彥卿女 as 皇后; Jinshu 053 names Western Jin 壽妻賈午, a different full personal name, kinship, and dynasty.
notes: Empress Fu of Later Zhou (daughter of 符彥卿) is not 賈午, wife of 韓壽 in the Minhuai biography. English romanization overlap is not identity.

basis: Jinshu 053 謝才人/謝妃/謝淑妃 is Minhuai's mother, interrogated to death; Weishu 068 前妻謝 is Wang Su's former wife and mother of 紹, arriving at 壽春 as Su died.
notes: Shared surname 謝 and English Lady Xie only. Western Jin heir's mother versus Southern-Qi/Wei wife of 王肅. No alias chain linking them.

basis: Mingshi 284 given name is 亨, younger brother of 元 in the Mencius sacrificial line; Jinshu 053 office-holder is 孟珩, 友 to the Prince of Guangling.
notes: 孟亨 versus 孟珩. Shared English Meng Heng is a valid romanization of two graphs, not a merge. Ming hereditary shrine versus Western Jin princely companion.

basis: Jinshu 053 personal name 閻纘 moves the emperor after Minhuai's burial; Beishi 087 燕榮有子詢, surname 燕 given name 詢 under Sui cruel-officials.
notes: 閻纘 versus 燕詢. Existing 053+ZZTJ group kept whole. English Yan Xun on the Beishi side matches 詢, not 纘, and does not identify the Jin remonstrant with Yan Rong's son.

basis: Jinshu 053 is 閻纘 after Minhuai's burial; Songshi 333 biography opens 閻詢，字議道，鳳翔天興人, a Song jinshi whose 詢之辭令 is praised.
notes: Same surname 閻, different given names 纘 versus 詢, Jin versus Song. Courtesy 議道 and Tianxing origin belong only to the Song man. Group with ZZTJ 閻纘 retained intact.

basis: Jinshu 053 杜錫 is Minhuai's 舍人; Zhoushu 046 映弟晰 is Direct Troops Attendant under Liang, killed on a false charge with 君錫 and 映.
notes: 杜錫 versus 杜晰. Shared English Du Xi is not identity. Liang 中直兵參軍, younger brother of 映, is a different man from Western Jin 杜錫.

basis: Beishi 016 representative is 陳武帝/霸先 attacking 廣陵; Jinshu 053 is 婢陳舞 forcing wine on Minhuai. Personal names 陳霸先 versus 陳舞.
notes: Chen Baxian / 陳武帝 group left intact and not merged with Western Jin maid 陳舞. English Chen Wu can render 武帝 or 陳舞; the Chinese names and narratives diverge.

basis: Jinshu 067 陳午 is the bandit band that captured 郗鑒; Jinshu 053 陳舞 is Empress Jia's maid. Graphs 午 versus 舞.
notes: 陳午 versus 陳舞. Shared English Chen Wu is accurate romanization of two names. Rebel captor of 郗鑒 is not the Minhuai palace maid.
